contentBlocks.heading: How does IB Gram shortlist an online IB tutor in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
You send a query or book a free consultation, and IB Gram asks about the board, programme, subject and level, your child's school calendar, your sector and the evening slots that are realistic. It then shortlists tutors whose verified profiles fit those needs and who teach online, and a demo session can be arranged before you commit.

An online request changes what matters in the match. Location almost drops out, because a tutor in another part of Gurugram, or further away, can teach a student in Sector 84 as easily as one in Sector 67. So the questions shift towards what decides whether a screen lesson will hold up: whether the student writes on a tablet or on paper held to a camera, whether the course is Maths Analysis and Approaches (AA) or Applications and Interpretation (AI), whether it is taken at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL), and which calculator model the school uses, since a tutor who knows that model can demonstrate keystrokes on a shared screen.

The demo tests online delivery as much as it tests the tutor. Ask the tutor to set a short problem, have your child solve it on the whiteboard, and watch whether a slip gets spotted as it happens. If the connection lags or your child goes quiet behind a switched-off camera, say so. You can ask for a different match if the fit is wrong, and one poor demo is reason enough to ask.

One honest limit. Availability of online HL specialists depends on subject, level and schedule, and the late slots that suit a DP2 student after activities are the same slots many families ask for. A family that can offer two or three possible times usually gets a wider shortlist than one with a single fixed evening. Mention whether your child sits the May or November session, so the shortlist reflects the real deadline.
items: 1. Send a query or book a free consultation with the subject, level and exam session.
2. IB Gram asks about syllabus, school calendar, sector, schedule and your child's device.
3. IB Gram shortlists online tutors whose verified profiles match those needs.
4. A demo or trial session can be arranged on the same video setup.
5. Lessons begin online or hybrid; you can ask for a different match if the fit is wrong.

contentBlocks.heading: How online IB lessons change from PYP to MYP to DP
contentBlocks.body:
The programme stage decides how long a screen lesson can run before it stops teaching anything. A DP student preparing for exams can usually hold a focused hour. An MYP student in the early years often manages less, and a PYP child may drift well before a long session ends, however skilled the tutor.

IB PYP online classes work only when they are short and full of activity. A seven-year-old in Sector 68 who has already spent part of the school day on devices will not sit through a talk-and-listen lesson. What works is a tutor who has the child reading aloud, drawing on the whiteboard, or fetching objects from around the house to count and hold up to the camera, with a parent in the next room for the first few sessions. For many PYP children, a home tutor or no tutor at all is the better answer, and a good online tutor will say so.

An IB MYP online tutor in Gurgaon has more room to work. A twelve- or thirteen-year-old can annotate a text or work a problem on a tablet, and older MYP students may prefer typed feedback they can reread before a school task. Screen fatigue is still real at this age. Build in a short break between tasks, close messaging apps, and end before attention goes.

Online tutoring is easiest to justify for Diploma students. The DP is a two-year course of six subjects, three or four at HL with 240 recommended teaching hours and the rest at SL with 150, each graded 1 to 7, with TOK and the Extended Essay (EE) adding up to 3 points towards a maximum of 45. Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) must be completed too. That load leaves little slack in a DP1 or DP2 week, so an IB DP online tutor whose lesson starts on time, with no travel on either side, gives back more of the evening than you might expect.
items: PYP: short, activity-led sessions with a parent nearby; home lessons often suit better.
MYP: tablet annotation works well, with planned breaks and messaging apps closed.
DP: a focused hour often works, scheduled around CAS and activity evenings.
Agree session length during the demo instead of copying a school timetable.

contentBlocks.heading: Which IB subjects work well online, and which do not?
contentBlocks.body:
Mathematics, Economics, English A and TOK work well online, because the work is written, calculated or discussed on a shared screen. Physics and Chemistry theory and problem-solving suit online too. Home lessons win for hands-on science with apparatus and for young PYP learners who need an adult beside them.

An online IB Maths tutor in Gurgaon can do almost everything a home tutor can. The student shares the screen of a graphic display calculator (GDC) emulator where the family has one, or holds a phone camera over the handheld, and the tutor follows each keystroke. Algebra and calculus run on a tablet with a stylus, with both people writing on the same page. The mathematics exploration, the Internal Assessment (IA) worth 20% of the final grade and marked out of 20 on five criteria, suits online feedback too: a tutor can question the student in the margin of a shared document without writing any of it. The school teacher can comment on one draft, and the work must be the student's own.

An online IB Physics tutor handles derivations, graph sketching and past-paper problems well, and Chemistry calculations move onto a whiteboard just as easily. The weak spot is anything involving apparatus. A tutor cannot steady a student's burette or check a circuit through a laptop camera, so practical skills stay with the school lab. Economics diagrams are drawn live and corrected line by line. English A essays can be annotated in a shared document, though timed handwritten practice is harder to supervise on camera.

TOK may be the most natural online subject of all. It is discussion-led, and both assessments are written: an exhibition of up to 950 words built on three objects, and an essay of up to 1,600 words on one of six prescribed titles. A student in Sector 109 can test a knowledge question with an online TOK tutor in Gurgaon on a Sunday afternoon, and the exchange loses very little on a screen.
items: Maths AA and AI: GDC keystrokes shared on screen, stylus working on a common page.
Physics and Chemistry: theory and calculations suit online; apparatus work stays in the school lab.
Economics: diagrams drawn live on the whiteboard and corrected as the student draws.
English A: essays annotated in a shared document; timed handwritten practice is harder to watch.
TOK: discussion-led, with written assessments, so very little is lost on a screen.

contentBlocks.heading: Does online IB tutoring suit your part of Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
Yes, for most families in the outer corridors of Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana: Dwarka Expressway, New Gurgaon, Manesar and NH-48 south, and the Southern Peripheral Road (SPR). Online removes the weekday evening drive that makes home tutoring hard to schedule here, and it brings in HL specialists who may not travel that far on a school night.

Many families along Dwarka Expressway, in Sectors 102, 103, 104, 106, 108, 109, 110 and 113, live in large gated societies. A home tutor visiting Godrej Summit, Sobha City or ATS Kocoon signs in at the gate and waits for a lift on every visit, and evening traffic on the expressway can stretch a short trip. An online lesson starts when your child sits down. The weak point is often inside the flat: if the router is in the living room and the study desk is in a far bedroom, test a video call from that desk at the hour the lesson will run.

In New Gurgaon the harder problem is finding the right specialist at all. A DP2 student in Sector 84 or Vatika India Next who needs HL Chemistry may find that the nearest suitable tutor lives on the other side of the city. The same holds in Sectors 82, 83, 85, 86, 89 and 90, in Godrej Air, and towards Kherki Daula and Pataudi Road, where a late home slot means a long drive back for the tutor. Keep the router on inverter backup if your power supply is unreliable, because a cut ends a video lesson at once.

Around IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk and Sectors 33, 34 and 37, evening traffic on NH-48 is hard to predict, so online is the practical weekday default and any home lessons fit better at weekends. On the SPR, hybrid earns its place. In Sectors 66, 67, 68, 69, 70 and 72, and around Ansal Esencia, Bhondsi and Tata Primanti, some families keep a home tutor for a younger PYP child and put the DP student's HL Maths online, where late slots are easier to find.
items: Godrej Summit, Sobha City, ATS Kocoon: no gate sign-in or lift wait before an online lesson.
Sector 84, Godrej Air, Pataudi Road: online widens the search for HL specialists.
IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk, Sectors 33, 34 and 37: online as the weekday default.
Sector 67, Ansal Esencia, Tata Primanti: hybrid, with home lessons for a younger PYP child.

contentBlocks.heading: School calendars that shape online IB lessons in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
For an IB student in Gurgaon, the school calendar, not the tutor, decides when the pressure arrives. May is the exam session most Gurgaon IB schools use, with results released in early July, and November is the other session. Everything before the exams runs on internal deadlines that each school sets for itself, so ask the DP coordinator for your child's dates instead of guessing.

Those internal deadlines tend to cluster, and a cluster is exactly when online tutoring earns its keep. A DP student may have a TOK exhibition, a subject draft and class tests falling in the same few weeks. A short online check-in on a weeknight, arranged around the draft rather than around a drive, is far easier to fit in than a home visit, subject to the tutor's schedule. TOK needs one planning note of its own: the six prescribed essay titles are released for each exam session, so an older cousin's essay plan from another session is no guide at all.

School timings add a second squeeze. After a full day, the bus home, sport and a CAS commitment, a DP1 student's realistic start time may be well into the evening. A home tutor may not want to begin a lesson that late in a sector far from their own. An online tutor can, where their schedule allows, and your child does not lose another half-hour waiting for someone to arrive. On a night before a test, that half-hour matters.

Expect schools to take academic integrity seriously, and plan online help around that. If your school asks students to declare outside support on assessed work, tell the tutor in the first week and share the policy. Nothing about online lessons makes ghostwriting easier to hide. A shared document keeps an edit history, and a good tutor prefers it that way.
items: May is the session most Gurgaon IB schools use; results arrive in early July.
Ask the DP coordinator for internal IA, TOK and test dates before planning lessons.
TOK prescribed titles are released for each session, so an older sibling's plan will not transfer.
Share the school's academic integrity policy with the online tutor in week one.

contentBlocks.heading: When online beats home tutoring in Gurgaon, and when it loses
contentBlocks.body:
For an IB student in Gurgaon, online tutoring offers the widest choice of subject specialists and the most flexible evening slots, but it depends on a reliable connection and a student who can focus on a screen. Home tutoring gives the closest supervision and suits young PYP children and handwritten timed practice, but it is limited by distance and weekday traffic. Hybrid combines the two and asks for the most planning.

An IB online tutor in Gurgaon is the stronger choice for work that can be written or argued on a shared screen: Maths AA and AI, Physics and Chemistry problem-solving, Economics diagrams, English A essays and TOK. For many families in New Gurgaon or near IMT Manesar, online is also the only realistic route to an HL specialist. The limits are just as plain. A student who keeps the camera off, a flat with patchy Wi-Fi or a young child who cannot stay with a screen will get much less from the hour.

Home lessons win when a PYP learner needs an adult at the table, when a DP student's handwriting under timed conditions needs watching, or when a teenager simply works harder with someone sitting beside them. The price is rigidity. A home slot is fixed by the tutor's drive, the society gate and the traffic, which often rules out late evenings and narrows the choice to tutors who live reasonably close.

Hybrid works as a fixed pattern, not as switching whenever it suits. One split that holds up is an online lesson midweek for problem sets or IA feedback and a home session at the weekend for a timed paper written by hand. It depends on one tutor who can do both, which comes down to where they live and their schedule, and it falls apart when the mode changes every week.
items: Online: widest specialist choice and late slots; needs steady Wi-Fi and a focused student.
Home: closest supervision for PYP children and timed handwritten papers; limited by traffic.
Hybrid: online midweek for problem sets, home at weekends for timed practice.
Online loses value with camera-off habits, patchy connections and very young learners.

contentBlocks.heading: How do you check a virtual IB tutor in Gurgaon before lessons begin?
contentBlocks.body:
IB Gram shortlists only tutors whose verified profiles match the subject, level and schedule you gave. Your own check happens in the demo: confirm the tutor knows the current IB course and its assessment, that their online setup works as well as yours, and that their habits with a child on camera are ones you accept.

Ask subject questions a generalist cannot bluff. A Maths tutor should be able to explain how they would help a student raise a weak score on criterion E, Use of mathematics, without doing the mathematics for them, and should know that HL work is judged against a higher standard on that criterion. For TOK, ask how they would test whether an exhibition object genuinely links to the IA prompt chosen. Ask an Economics tutor to draw a diagram live and explain each label, and a Physics or Chemistry tutor to talk through a past-paper answer on screen as they would in a lesson. Listen for precision, not confidence.

Then look at the tutor's side of the screen. A tutor should teach from a quiet room with a working camera, write with a stylus or pen tablet rather than a mouse, and share and annotate a past paper without fumbling. Ask what happens if their own connection fails mid-lesson; a tutor with a hotspot ready and a clear make-up rule has taught online for a while.

Last come the habits that protect a child online. A younger student's lessons should run with the laptop in a shared room, where a parent can pass by. Messages belong in a channel a parent can see, never in a private chat with the child. Recordings should be made only with your consent, and you should know where they are kept and who can view them. A careful tutor raises these points before you do.
items: Confirm the tutor teaches the current IB course and knows its assessment criteria.
Ask a Maths tutor how they would coach criterion E without doing the work.
Watch the tutor annotate a past paper on screen during the demo.
Keep messages in a channel a parent can see, never a private chat.
Agree recording consent, storage and viewing access before the first full lesson.

contentBlocks.heading: What does your child need for a live online IB lesson at home?
contentBlocks.body:
Your child needs a laptop or desktop with a webcam, a headset with a microphone, a tablet and stylus or a pen tablet, broadband tested at lesson time with a phone hotspot as backup, and a quiet, well-lit desk. Add the school calculator, a charger and downloaded past papers. A phone on its own is too small for DP work.

Each piece has a job. A one-to-one online IB tutor opens a shared whiteboard and both people write on it, so a sign error in a Physics derivation or a missing label on a supply curve is caught as it appears. Past papers can be annotated together as PDFs and saved to a shared folder your child can reopen before a test. For Maths AA or AI, the calculator screen is shared through an emulator or a phone camera, so the tutor sees keystrokes rather than just answers. A headset stops laptop speakers feeding echo into the call.

Recordings can help, subject to your family's consent. A DP student revising for May can replay the few minutes in which a hard question was untangled, but a family that wants no recordings should say so at the start. Attention needs setting up too. Put your child at a desk, not on a bed, with the phone in another room and notifications off. Keep the camera on, because a tutor who can see a puzzled face stops and re-explains.

Picture a DP1 student in Sector 70 logging in at 8 pm after football, headset on, tablet beside the laptop. The tutor drops a past-paper question onto the whiteboard, watches the working appear line by line and corrects it on the same page. Nobody drove anywhere. That is what live online IB classes in Gurgaon should look like, and it is what separates genuine IB online tuition in Gurugram from a recorded lecture.
items: Laptop or desktop with a webcam, placed so the tutor sees the student's face.
Tablet and stylus, or a pen tablet, so maths and diagrams are written, not typed.
Headset with a microphone to stop echo and block household noise.
Broadband tested from the desk at lesson time, with a phone hotspot as backup.
Calculator, charger and past papers on the desk; phone in another room.

contentBlocks.heading: How can you tell within three sessions whether online is working?
contentBlocks.body:
By the third session, your child should be writing on the shared whiteboard without being asked, reasoning aloud with the camera on, and able to explain one idea they could not explain before. The tutor should be catching mistakes as they happen and checking the work set last time. If those signs are missing, change the setup, slot or mode.

Three sessions will not move a school grade, and no tutor can guarantee one. What they can show is whether working with an IB online tutor in Gurgaon suits this particular child. A student who keeps the camera off, answers in single words, or loses part of every lesson to a dropped connection is telling you something. The fix may be as small as a headset or an earlier slot before tiredness sets in, or as large as moving to home lessons.

For PYP and MYP children, add one more check: how they look when the lesson ends. A child who comes away rubbing their eyes, irritable, or unable to say what was covered has had too long on the screen, whatever the timetable says. Shorten the session, split it into two across the week, or keep the younger child's lessons at home. An eleven-year-old who is bright and chatty for the first twenty minutes and then glazes over is not being lazy; the session is simply longer than their attention span.

Be honest about the limits too. Starting late narrows what is possible: a DP2 student who begins online lessons a few weeks before an internal deadline can still sharpen understanding and structure, but cannot rebuild two years of content in a term. And online cannot fix a student who is overloaded across six subjects and CAS. Sometimes the right call is a conversation with the school about workload before any tutor is added.
items: Session one: camera on, headset working, student writing on the whiteboard by the end.
Session two: the tutor catches errors live and checks last time's task.
Session three: your child explains one idea they could not explain before.
Tired eyes or no recall afterwards: shorten the PYP or MYP session.
No tutor can guarantee a grade; judge a month of classwork, not one test.

contentBlocks.heading: Getting started with an IB online tutor in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Send a query or book a free consultation with the subject, level, exam session, your sector and the evening slots your child can manage. Before the demo, gather three things: your child's most recent marked work in the subject with any teacher comments, the term's internal deadlines if the school has shared them, and a short list of the topics your child finds hardest, written in their own words. That list often tells a tutor more than a report card.

Run a rehearsal the evening before. Open a video call from the study desk at the time the lesson will actually happen, check that the stylus writes on a shared whiteboard, and plug the headset in. If your child uses a calculator emulator, open it once in advance. Ten minutes of checking the night before saves the first fifteen of the demo.

A useful first session covers four things. The tutor checks sound, camera and whiteboard on both sides. Then comes a short diagnostic task, chosen to show how your child thinks through a problem rather than simply whether the final answer is right. Next, the tutor and your family agree the practical rules: how homework is shared, how messages reach a parent and whether sessions are recorded. Finally, the tutor proposes the next few topics, tied to the school's upcoming deadlines.

Stay within earshot for the first ten minutes if your child is in PYP or early MYP, then step away once the lesson is running. If the demo does not feel right, say so plainly. You can ask for a different match, and a second demo is a normal step, not a failure. Some families discover after a trial that online is not right for their child, and switching to home or hybrid lessons at that point is a sensible decision.
items: Latest marked work in the subject, with any teacher comments on drafts.
The term's internal deadlines, or the DP coordinator's contact for dates.
A rehearsal video call from the study desk the evening before.
A list of the hardest topics, written in your child's own words.
Decisions on recording consent and a parent-visible channel for messages.

faqs.question: Does online IB tutoring really work as well as home tutoring?
faqs.answer: For most DP and older MYP students, yes, because the tutor sees every line of working on a shared whiteboard and nothing is lost to travel. It works less well for young PYP children, for timed handwritten practice and for students who hide behind a switched-off camera. The honest test is the demo and the two sessions after it. If your child is talking, writing and correcting mistakes on screen by then, the medium is not the problem.

faqs.question: Is a laptop enough, or does my child need a tablet and stylus?
faqs.answer: A laptop is enough for TOK and English A, but a stylus makes a real difference for Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Economics diagrams. Writing an integral or a demand curve with a mouse is slow and messy, and the tutor ends up correcting the drawing instead of the thinking. A pen tablet that plugs into the laptop is a simple fix. Another is a phone clamped above the desk as a document camera, so your child writes on paper while the tutor watches.

faqs.question: Can an online tutor give feedback on my child's maths exploration?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as the feedback comes as questions and pointers and the work remains your child's own. The mathematics exploration is 20% of the final grade and is marked out of 20 on five criteria, and the school teacher can comment on one draft. An online tutor can open a shared copy and ask in the margin why a method was chosen or what a result means, which prompts your child's own reflection rather than replacing it. Rewriting sections or supplying mathematics to paste in crosses the line.

faqs.question: Are online IB lessons recorded, and who keeps the recordings?
faqs.answer: Lessons should be recorded only with your family's consent, and that decision belongs before the first session. Recordings help a DP student replay a hard explanation before a test, but they are optional, and some families choose none. If you do agree, settle three points with the tutor: where the file is stored, who can view it and when it is deleted. No student should be recorded without a parent knowing, and a tutor who resists these questions is the wrong tutor.

faqs.question: How much screen time is sensible for a PYP or MYP child in online lessons?
faqs.answer: Keep online lessons short for a PYP child, ending before attention drifts, and allow MYP students longer sessions with a break between tasks. For many young PYP learners, home lessons are simply the better choice. Count the whole school day as well, because a child who has already used devices in class and done homework online is not starting fresh at 6 pm. Tired eyes, irritability or no memory of what was covered all mean the session ran too long.

faqs.question: We live in Sobha City on Dwarka Expressway. Is online better than a home tutor on weekday evenings?
faqs.answer: Often, yes, because an online lesson takes gate entry and evening traffic out of the plan and makes a later slot possible. A home tutor may still be available in your sector, subject to their location and schedule, but a slot that depends on a drive along the expressway at peak time is the first to slip. A practical pattern in Sectors 106, 108 and 109 is online lessons midweek and, where a nearby tutor exists, one home session at the weekend.

faqs.question: What if the online tutor is not working out?
faqs.answer: Tell IB Gram and ask for a different match; there is no need to sit through a month of poor lessons. Be specific, because the reason shapes the next shortlist. A tutor who talks for most of the hour, rarely asks your child to write, joins late or struggles with the whiteboard is a different problem from a skilled tutor who simply does not click with your child. Say which it is, and mention anything the demo missed.

faqs.question: My child has had online lessons for a month and nothing has improved. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Pin down exactly what has not improved, then deal with that specific problem before changing anything else. Compare the tutor's notes with your child's recent school work. If the same errors keep returning, the lessons are not targeting them and the tutor needs to change approach. If classwork looks better but one test mark does not, a single test may be misleading. Talk to the tutor, then the subject teacher, and if nothing shifts, ask IB Gram for a different match or try hybrid lessons.

faqs.question: Is online IB tutoring cheaper than home tutoring in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Not automatically, because the fee depends mostly on the subject, level and tutor rather than on the mode alone. Online removes travel, which can affect how a tutor prices lessons and how late they can teach, but an experienced HL specialist teaching online is not necessarily cheaper than a home tutor nearby. Judge value instead: whether the online hour starts on time, uses every minute and targets the gaps your child's school work shows.

faqs.question: Can my child find an HL specialist online if nobody nearby teaches the subject?
faqs.answer: Often, yes, because a search for an IB online tutor in Gurgaon is not limited to tutors who can reach your sector, though it still depends on subject, level and schedule. This matters most for less common needs, such as HL Chemistry alongside Maths AA at HL, and for families in New Gurgaon, on Pataudi Road or around IMT Manesar. The trade-off is that the specialist may never meet your child in person, so the demo carries more weight.

heroTitle: What Actually Moves a Tutoring Fee in Gurgaon
heroSubtitle: International Baccalaureate (IB) tutoring fees shift with the programme stage, from the Primary Years Programme (PYP) through the Middle Years Programme (MYP) to the Diploma Programme (DP). They also move with Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL) study, subject scarcity, session length and travel. This page ranks each factor and shows how to test a quote.
introSummary: IB tutor fees in Gurgaon are set mainly by the programme stage and level, how scarce the subject specialist is, the tutor's IB experience, session length and whether you choose home tuition or online lessons. A Grade 4 PYP reader and a DP2 student taking HL Physics need very different things, and the fee reflects that. Mentoring for the Internal Assessment (IA), Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) is often priced separately from subject teaching, and crash revision close to the May exams tends to cost more per session than steady support started in DP1. The sections below rank those factors, explain billing and list questions for a demo. There are no price figures here. Quotes vary too much by tutor and schedule for a number to help you.

contentBlocks.heading: How a Gurgaon Fee Enquiry Turns Into a Shortlist
contentBlocks.body:
Most parents who call about IB tutor fees in Gurgaon want a number first, and that is a fair place to start. But a fee only means something once it is attached to a specific need: the programme, the subjects and their level, the weeks left before a school deadline, and where lessons will happen. So the first conversation is mostly questions. You send IB Gram a query or book a free consultation, and we ask about the board, the syllabus, the level, your school calendar, where you live in Gurgaon and which evenings are genuinely free.

Those answers narrow the field before price comes into it. A DP1 student in Sector 57 who wants steady HL Chemistry support through the year needs a different tutor from a DP2 student in Sector 104 who has left Economics revision until after the school mocks. The first family can settle into a weekly rhythm and spread the cost across months. The second needs someone with spare evenings at short notice, which narrows the choice and often lifts the per-session fee.

From there, IB Gram shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified and whose experience matches the request, subject to their availability. Ask about each tutor's fee, the billing unit and the cancellation terms at this stage, before the first paid lesson. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, and it is the most reliable way to test whether a higher quote is justified. If the fit turns out to be wrong a few weeks in, you can ask for a different match instead of paying for lessons that are not working.

Be wary of anyone who pushes a long package before you have seen a single lesson. A tutor who knows their subject is usually happy to let the first few sessions make the case.
items: 1. You send IB Gram a query or book a free consultation.
2. IB Gram asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule.
3. IB Gram shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified and match the student's needs, subject to availability.
4. A demo or trial session can be arranged so you can judge fit before committing.
5. Lessons run at home, online or hybrid, and you can ask for a different match.

contentBlocks.heading: PYP, MYP or DP: How Stage and Billing Shape the Fee
contentBlocks.body:
Programme stage is the first thing that moves a quote, because it decides how specialised the tutor has to be. In the Primary Years Programme (PYP), a patient teacher used to young learners can usually support reading, numeracy and class projects, and sessions are shorter. That keeps PYP fees at the lower end of what IB families pay. Many PYP children need no tutor at all, and a family should hear that from a counsellor before spending anything.

Middle Years Programme (MYP) support sits in between. Subjects widen, tasks become more open-ended, and a tutor needs to understand how IB tasks are assessed rather than simply teaching content ahead. Families comparing IB MYP tuition fees often find quotes rise in the later MYP years. The hourly rate may not change much, but a student who needs two sessions a week instead of one doubles the monthly bill.

The Diploma Programme (DP) is where fees climb most. It is a two-year course, DP1 and DP2, with six subjects drawn from six groups: three or four at Higher Level, each with 240 recommended teaching hours, and the rest at Standard Level, with 150 hours each. Every subject is graded 1-7, and TOK and the EE together add up to 3 more points, for a maximum of 45. A tutor working to that scale needs real subject depth and exam awareness, and IB DP tuition fees reflect it. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

Billing usually takes one of three shapes. Per-session pricing suits occasional doubt-solving. A monthly arrangement covers a fixed number of weekly sessions and suits steady DP1 support. Packages bundle a set number of hours for a defined job, such as IA help or pre-May revision, and should state what happens to unused hours.
items: PYP support needs shorter sessions and less specialist knowledge, so fees usually sit lower.
DP HL subjects carry 240 recommended teaching hours against 150 at SL.
Per-session billing suits occasional doubts; monthly billing suits a fixed weekly rhythm.
Packages should state included hours, validity and what happens to unused sessions.

contentBlocks.heading: Why HL Maths AA, Physics and Chemistry Often Cost More
contentBlocks.body:
HL Maths AA, Physics and Chemistry tutors in Gurgaon tend to quote more than SL tutors in the same subjects. That is a tendency, not a rule. The gap comes from the volume of material, the demand for these subjects and the shorter list of people who can teach them confidently at Higher Level.

Start with volume. An HL subject carries 240 recommended teaching hours against 150 at SL, so there is more to teach and more to revise. A tutor comfortable with SL Maths is not automatically right for an HL student, and good HL tutors know their field is small. Demand adds pressure. Families aiming at engineering or physical science degrees often ask for exactly this combination, so the tutors who handle it well tend to have full weekday evenings. That is why IB Maths tutor fees in Gurgaon at HL can sit noticeably above an SL quote, sometimes from the same tutor.

But do not assume the HL rate is always the one to pay. A capable SL student who needs three sessions on one weak topic does not need an HL specialist, and an HL student who is already secure may only need past-paper feedback, which a shorter session can cover. Some SL students struggle more than HL students do, because they took the subject for breadth rather than interest. Match the tutor to the difficulty the student actually has.

Coursework mentoring is usually quoted separately from subject teaching. IA help fees, EE guidance and TOK discussion sessions are often sold as a small block of hours, and that block should cover planning, questioning and feedback on drafts, never writing. A tutor who offers to produce IA or EE work for a fee is selling something no family should buy. Scarcity matters outside the sciences too: a less commonly taught language, or a subject with few specialists in the city, can cost more because the choice is thin.
items: Higher Level depth, more than the subject itself, usually lifts the quote.
Fewer tutors teach HL Maths AA, Physics and Chemistry confidently, so evenings fill early.
An SL student with one weak topic rarely needs an HL specialist's rate.
IA, EE and TOK mentoring is often priced as a separate block of hours.

contentBlocks.heading: Travel, Traffic and Home Tutor Charges Across Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Home tutoring in Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, carries a cost that never appears on a syllabus: the tutor's travel. IB home tutor charges in Gurgaon usually build in the time spent reaching you, which on weekday evenings depends on your corridor and the tutor's starting point. On Golf Course Road, families in DLF Phase 1, DLF Phase 5, Sector 42, Sector 43, Sector 53, Sector 54, Ardee City and Wazirabad, including societies such as DLF The Magnolias, DLF The Aralias, DLF Park Place, DLF The Crest and DLF The Belaire, often find home lessons workable, though evening traffic can stretch even a short trip. Visitor approvals at society gates eat into a session too, so agree whether the paid hour starts at the gate or the study table.

Golf Course Extension Road takes in Sector 56, Sector 57, Sector 58, Sector 59, Sector 60, Sector 62, Sector 65, Sushant Lok 3, Ghata and Gwal Pahari, with societies such as M3M Golf Estate, Ireo Grand Arch and Ireo Skyon. A tutor already teaching on Golf Course Road may fit in a Sector 58 or Sector 62 slot, but crossing from Sohna Road on a weekday evening is another matter, and that is where a travel premium creeps in.

Sohna Road covers Sector 47, Sector 48, Sector 49, Sector 50, Nirvana Country, South City 2, Rosewood City, Uppal Southend, Vatika Chowk and Badshahpur, with societies including Central Park Resorts, Orchid Petals, Vatika City, Malibu Towne, Vipul Greens and The Close. Here a weekend home session paired with a weekday online session often gives better value than paying for travel twice a week.

On Dwarka Expressway, families in Sector 102, Sector 103, Sector 104, Sector 106, Sector 108, Sector 109, Sector 110 and Sector 113, including Godrej Summit, Sobha City and ATS Kocoon, face the sharpest trade-off when the specialist they need is based elsewhere in the city. Paying for that journey every week can cost more than it adds, so online or hybrid lessons usually serve these families better.
items: Golf Course Road: agree whether society gate entry time counts inside the paid hour.
Golf Course Extension Road: a tutor already nearby may fit in a Sector 58 slot.
Sohna Road: weekend home lessons plus weekday online often cost less than twice-weekly travel.
Dwarka Expressway: online or hybrid usually wins when the right specialist is far away.

contentBlocks.heading: When to Spend: The DP1 and DP2 Budget in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Money spent early in the Diploma Programme usually goes further than money spent late. May is the exam session most Gurgaon IB schools use, with results released in early July, so the whole DP budget works backwards from that May. Families who hold everything back for DP2 often end up paying crash revision rates for problems that were visible in DP1.

A sensible way to spread IB tutor fees in Gurgaon across the two years looks like this. In the first months of DP1, spend only where a gap is real: an HL Maths AA or Physics student already losing marks on school tests, or a student who has joined from another board and needs to learn how IB questions are answered. Weekly sessions in one or two subjects are usually enough. Later in DP1, as coursework begins on a timeline each school sets, IA planning, EE research questions and TOK thinking are where a short, well-defined mentoring block earns its fee, because a late start compresses everything.

DP2 is where many families overspend. It tends to bunch IA drafts, EE completion and school mock exams close together, though each school sets the dates. Rather than adding sessions in every subject, concentrate on the one or two where a grade is genuinely movable. After the mocks, a fixed revision package built around past papers and timed practice usually gives more value than open-ended weekly lessons. Confirm the internal calendar with your school's DP coordinator before booking anything.

International school families in Gurgaon also juggle Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) commitments, school trips, university applications and festival holidays, any of which can cancel sessions. Ask how missed lessons are handled, and whether they roll over, before you sign a monthly plan. And keep a small reserve for the weeks after mocks, when a weak paper sometimes needs attention nobody planned for.
items: Early DP1: fund only real gaps, usually one or two HL subjects weekly.
Later DP1, as coursework begins: a short, defined IA, EE or TOK mentoring block.
DP2: concentrate spending on subjects where a grade can still genuinely move.
After school mocks: a fixed past-paper package usually beats open-ended weekly lessons.
Before a monthly plan: ask how sessions missed for CAS, trips or holidays are handled.

contentBlocks.heading: Is Home, Online or Hybrid Tutoring Better Value in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
Online lessons usually give the most value for DP subject work in Gurgaon, because the fee is not carrying travel time and the choice of specialist is not limited to your corridor. Home lessons usually cost more but earn it for young PYP children and for students who drift without someone beside them. Hybrid suits most Diploma families.

Here is the plain trade-off between home, online and hybrid IB tutoring in Gurgaon. A home tutor charges for the lesson and, directly or indirectly, for the journey. Because weekday evening traffic limits how many homes a tutor can reach, home slots are scarcer and priced higher. In return, the tutor can watch handwritten working line by line and notice the moment a younger child's attention slips. IB online tutor fees usually carry no travel element, so the same budget can buy more sessions or a more experienced specialist, provided the student stays engaged on a screen. Hybrid tutoring, with a home session at the weekend and online sessions on school nights, sits between the two on cost and suits most DP1 and DP2 students.

When families weigh the cost of an IB tutor per hour in Gurgaon, a home hour and an online hour rarely describe the same thing. A home quote may fold in travel, set a minimum session length or add a charge for late slots, while an online hour is usually teaching time and nothing else. Ask each tutor what the hour contains.

Take a DP2 student in Sector 109 who needs HL Chemistry and SL Economics, and suppose the best-fitting Chemistry tutor is based near Sohna Road. Paying for that trip twice a week mostly buys traffic. Two online sessions with the same tutor on school nights, plus one Saturday home session before the mocks for timed papers at the dining table, usually buy more teaching for the money.
items: Home: usually the highest fee, as travel is built in; suits young or distracted learners.
Online: no travel element and a wider pool of HL specialists; needs a self-disciplined student.
Hybrid: weekend home sessions plus weeknight online lessons, usually mid-range in cost.
Compare like for like: ask what a home hour includes beyond teaching time.

contentBlocks.heading: Which Fees Are Red Flags, and What Should You Ask?
contentBlocks.body:
A fee is a red flag when it is far below or far above what similar IB tutors quote for the same level and subject, and the tutor cannot explain why. A very low fee often means no real IB experience. A very high one often leans on claims you cannot check. The right questions expose both.

Low quotes are tempting, and an affordable IB tutor in Gurgaon certainly exists: a younger tutor with strong subject knowledge and recent IB experience can be excellent value. The risk is a tutor teaching CBSE or JEE content under an IB label. Ask how a DP subject is graded, what HL adds over SL in their subject, and how they use past papers and markschemes. Ask how they give IA feedback without doing the work. Vague answers tell you what the low fee is buying.

High quotes deserve the same scrutiny. Examining experience is a fair reason for a higher fee, but only when it is real and relevant: a tutor should be able to say which subject and which component they marked, and how recently, without sharing anything confidential. Be cautious with anyone who promises a particular grade, hints at knowing what will appear on a paper, or wants a full term paid upfront before the first lesson. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and a premium fee does not change that. At the top end, expect visible preparation between sessions.

IB Gram shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified, but a profile cannot tell you whether a tutor suits your child. Sit in on the demo if your child is comfortable with that, or ask them specific questions afterwards: what did the tutor explain that the school had not, and what are they meant to practise before the next session? Any experience used to justify a higher fee should be visible in that first hour.
items: Too low: ask how a DP subject is graded and what HL adds.
Too low: ask how they give IA feedback without writing any part of it.
Too high: ask which subject and component they examined, and how recently.
Walk away from grade promises, hints about paper content or full-term prepayment demands.

contentBlocks.heading: What Decides How Much an IB Tutor Costs in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
The cost of an IB tutor in Gurgaon has no single figure. Six factors move it, roughly from biggest to smallest: programme stage and level, subject scarcity, the tutor's IB and examining experience, home travel versus online, the kind of work needed (IA, EE, TOK or crash revision), and session length and billing. So "How much does an IB tutor cost?" really means six smaller questions.

Stage and level come first because they set the floor: an HL tutor in DP2 covers more demanding content than a PYP tutor. Subject scarcity comes next. HL Maths AA, Physics and Chemistry, and subjects with few local specialists, draw higher quotes. Third is experience. A tutor who has taught the DP through several exam cycles, or who has examined, is charging for knowing where marks are usually lost, and that knowledge can save weeks of misdirected work.

Travel is fourth, and families often underestimate it. The same tutor may quote more for a home visit across town than for an online hour, because the evening journey eats teaching time. Fifth is the type of work. IA help fees and EE or TOK mentoring are usually priced as focused blocks, while crash revision in the weeks before May tends to cost more per session because most DP2 families want the same evenings. Last comes session length and billing. Longer sessions cost more, and monthly plans or packages lower the effective rate only if the hours are actually used.

Use this order when you compare quotes. Two tutors who differ on the first three factors should differ in price. Two who look alike but sit far apart deserve a question. If a quote for HL Physics with examining experience looks oddly low, ask why before feeling lucky. Batch classes are a separate case: IB coaching fees in Gurugram usually work out lower per student, but a batch built for CBSE or JEE rarely fits IB assessment, so weigh fit before price.
items: 1. Programme stage and level: DP HL usually costs most, then DP SL, MYP and PYP.
2. Subject scarcity: HL Maths AA, Physics, Chemistry and rarely taught subjects draw higher quotes.
3. Tutor experience: several DP exam cycles or genuine examining experience raise the fee.
4. Mode: home lessons carry travel time on weekday evenings; online lessons do not.
5. Type of work: IA, EE and TOK mentoring blocks and pre-May crash revision are priced separately.
6. Session length and billing: longer sessions cost more; packages help only if used.

contentBlocks.heading: What Progress Should a Fee Buy, and by When?
contentBlocks.body:
Within the first month or so, a fee should buy visible changes in how the student works: fewer repeated errors, better-structured written answers, a clear plan for coursework and more confidence with unseen questions. Grade changes take longer, often a full school term, and no tutor can guarantee a grade at any price.

Expect the tutor to show this rather than claim it. After the first few sessions, a good tutor should be able to tell you which topics or skills are weakest, what they are doing about each, and how you will both know it is working. For a DP student, that might mean a marked past-paper question in week one and a comparable one a month later. For an MYP student, it might mean a school task planned more clearly than the last. If you are paying extra for experience, this is where the extra should show.

Some limits are worth hearing before you pay. A tutor cannot rescue a subject the student has stopped attending to in class, and two sessions a week cannot replace independent practice. Starting late in DP2 narrows what is possible: there is time to sharpen exam answers, but rarely time to rebuild weak foundations across a whole HL course. And some students do not need a tutor at all. A student holding steady at the level they need, with a sensible revision plan, may be better served by the school's own support and a quiet desk.

IB tuition fees in Gurgaon are worth paying only while something is changing. If there is no progress after a month, raise it directly rather than letting it drift. Ask the tutor what has changed and what the next four weeks will do differently. If the answers are thin, you can ask IB Gram for a different match instead of continuing to pay out of politeness.
items: First month: fewer repeated errors and a written plan for the weakest topics.
First term: marked past-paper answers improving on comparable questions.
Coursework: IA and EE drafts moving on the school's deadlines, not the tutor's.
Still stuck after a month: ask IB Gram for a different match.

contentBlocks.heading: What a Demo Should Settle Before You Pay
contentBlocks.body:
Before any payment, the consultation and the demo should settle five things: what the fee covers, how it is billed, what happens to cancelled or missed sessions, what the tutor will work on first and how progress will be reported to you. If any of these is still vague after the demo, do not pay yet. The consultation is free, so use it to raise the awkward questions early.

Prepare a little before you send a query. Keep the student's subject list with HL and SL levels to hand, along with the latest school report, one or two marked tests or IA drafts, and the school calendar for the current term if you have it. Note the evening and weekend slots that are genuinely free once school buses, activities and traffic are counted, and have your sector or society name ready. Decide privately on a monthly budget ceiling too; it makes an attractive package that does not fit much easier to refuse.

The first session should be mostly diagnosis. Expect the tutor to look through marked work, have the student attempt a few questions aloud or on paper, and pin down where marks are being lost. By the end you should hear a plain plan: which topics come first, how often to meet and roughly how many sessions the immediate goal needs. That last answer is what turns a fee into a budget.

Ask the money questions directly, and get the answers in writing where you can. Is the demo itself charged? Does the rate change between home and online lessons, or for longer sessions before mocks? Are IA or EE mentoring hours billed separately? Can an unused package be refunded or moved to another subject if the match does not work? Families comparing IB tutor cost in Gurugram across two or three quotes learn a lot from how plainly these are answered.
items: Bring the subject list with HL and SL levels, latest report and marked tests.
Share free evening and weekend slots after school buses, activities and traffic.
Ask whether the demo is charged and what each paid hour includes.
Get cancellation, missed-session and package refund terms in writing before paying.

faqs.question: Why doesn't this page give a price range for IB tutor fees in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: A range would mislead more families than it would help. IB tutor fees in Gurgaon move with the programme, HL or SL level, subject, the tutor's experience, travel and the kind of work needed, so two quotes for the same subject can be far apart and both be fair. A range also anchors you to a number before you know what your child needs. Ask shortlisted tutors for quotes, then compare them using the factors above.

faqs.question: Is it better to pay per session, monthly or for a package?
faqs.answer: Pay per session while you are still testing a tutor, then move to a monthly plan or package once the fit is proven. Per-session billing leaves you free to stop. Monthly plans suit steady weekly support in DP1 or the MYP. Packages make sense for a defined job with an end date, such as IA mentoring or pre-May revision. Before buying one, check how long the hours stay valid and whether unused sessions are refundable.

faqs.question: Do home tutors charge more to reach Sector 108 or Sector 113 on Dwarka Expressway?
faqs.answer: Often, yes, if the tutor has to cross the city on weekday evenings to get there. Many home tutors build travel into their rate, and a long evening journey to Sector 108, Sector 113 or societies such as Sobha City and Godrej Summit eats into teaching time. Some tutors add a separate travel charge instead. Ask which applies. For a Dwarka Expressway family, online weekday lessons with an occasional weekend home session usually give more teaching for the same budget.

faqs.question: Is it worth paying more for a tutor who has been an IB examiner?
faqs.answer: It can be, for DP2 students who are losing marks on how they answer rather than on what they know. An examiner tends to spot quickly why a response falls short, which sharpens exam technique before May. For DP1 foundations or an MYP student, a strong teacher without examining experience is usually enough. Before paying the premium, ask which subject and component the tutor marked and how recently, and expect that insight to show in the demo.

faqs.question: How are IA help fees usually charged?
faqs.answer: IA help is usually charged as a short block of sessions per subject rather than as ongoing weekly lessons. A sensible block covers shaping a workable question, planning, feedback on a draft and a final check before the school's deadline. It should never include writing any part of the IA. Ask how many sessions the block contains, whether draft reading between sessions is included, and whether a second subject's IA is priced the same way.

faqs.question: Why does crash revision before the May exams cost more per session?
faqs.answer: Crash revision usually costs more per session because demand for experienced DP tutors peaks in the same few weeks. Most Gurgaon IB schools use the May session, so DP2 students across the city want evening and weekend slots at once, and tutors with spare time can charge for it. Sessions also tend to be longer and need more preparation. If the budget is tight, book a revision block early rather than paying peak rates at short notice.

faqs.question: We paid for a package and the tutor isn't working out. What now?
faqs.answer: Raise it quickly and specifically rather than quietly finishing the package. Tell the tutor what is not working, whether that is pace, explanations or preparation, and give it two or three sessions to change. If nothing moves, you can ask IB Gram for a different match. Check the refund or transfer terms you agreed before the first payment, which is why terms belong in writing. Waiting for the package to run out usually costs more than one awkward conversation.

faqs.question: Are IB online tutor fees lower than home tuition, and is the value really the same?
faqs.answer: Online fees are often lower than home fees, and for most DP subject work the value holds up well. The saving comes from removing travel, which also widens the choice beyond tutors near your sector in Gurgaon. The trade-off is attention. A self-motivated DP student usually does well online, while a young PYP child or a student who drifts may waste paid time on a screen. A trial session settles it faster than any argument.

faqs.question: Our daughter is starting DP1 and we live in Nirvana Country. Should we pay for a tutor now or wait for DP2?
faqs.answer: Pay now only if there is a specific gap; otherwise hold the budget for coursework mentoring and targeted DP2 support. If she is already struggling with an HL subject, a weekly session from early DP1 usually costs less overall than a rescue in DP2. If she is coping, wait and review after the first set of school tests. From Nirvana Country on Sohna Road, online weekday sessions avoid paying for evening travel while the need is still small.

faqs.question: Can we negotiate an IB tutor's fee?
faqs.answer: You can usually negotiate the structure more easily than the hourly rate. Experienced IB tutors often will not cut their rate much, but many will consider a monthly plan, a defined package, online sessions instead of travel, or a shorter session for doubt-solving. Those changes lower what you spend without asking the tutor to value their time less. Be cautious if a tutor drops the rate sharply the moment you hesitate, since that suggests the first quote was arbitrary.
